source.name: 4-Point Tummy Vacuum
source.how_to:
Here is how you can perform the 4-point tummy vacuum exercise:
1. Start on your hands and knees.
2. Maintain a neutral spine.
3. Inhale deeply through your nose.
4. Exhale and pull your belly button toward your spine.

source.name: Adductor Magnus Stretch
source.how_to:
The Thigh Fly as a static stretch:
1. Starting Position: Lie on your back with your legs together, lifted towards the ceiling.
2. Stretching Movement: Slowly open your legs to the sides as far as comfortable. Hold for 10-15 seconds.

source.name: Plate Push
source.how_to:
1. Place a weight plate flat on a smooth floor.
2. Get into a low athletic stance: hips back, chest down, hands on the edge of the plate, arms extended.
3. Engage your core, and drive through the balls of your feet to push the plate forward.
